abilities.effect: A spectral triceratops appears around the figurine and charges toward the triggering creature, affecting a line 30 feet long. Creatures in this area take 4d10+22 bludgeoning damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save).
abilities.name: Triceratops Trample

traits.name: Necromancy
traits.text: Effects and magic items with this trait are associated with the necromancy school of magic, typically involving forces of life and death.

traits.name: Primal
traits.text:
This magic comes from the primal tradition, connecting to the natural world and instinct. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to primal magic.

abilities.trigger: A living creature approaches within 10 feet of the figurine

hazard.description: This figurine of a charging triceratops was crafted from the dinosaur's femur and contains its spirit.
hazard.disable: DC 24 Nature (expert) to banish the dinosaur's spirit with a primal incantation, DC 28 Intimidation to scare it off with a frightening display, or DC 26 Survival (expert) to calm the spirit
hazard.name: Wrathful Dinosaur

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
